BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to residence modifications for injured workers;adding a new section to chapter 51.36 RCW; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 51.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature finds that there is a need to improve thestandards under which the department provides residence modificationassistance to workers who have sustained catastrophic injury. (2) The director shall adopt rules that take effect no later thannine months after the effective date of this section to establishstandards for residence modification pursuant to RCW 51.36.020(7).These rules must address at least the following: (a) The rules must use, as guidelines, the standards on adaptiveresidential housing adopted by the federal department of veteransaffairs; (b) For purposes of determining the needs and requirements of theworker under RCW 51.36.020(7) or determining whether a modification ismedically necessary, the department must give substantial weight to theopinion of the worker's attending health services provider. p. 1 EHB 2185 (3) In developing rules under this section, the director shallconsult with other persons with an interest in improving standards foradaptive housing. (4) The director shall report by January 31, 2006, to theappropriate committees of the legislature on the rules adopted underthis section.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
